Have a feeling Onchain AI might accelerate 10x+ by the end this year

We're seeing rapid growth of top teams on Base already
> @AskVenice already hit 500B tok/day, up 2x from Sep
> @AskSurplus set to hit 240B tok/day up 2.5x from Sep 
> @dphnAI hit ~14B tok/day a few days after public API

Bittensor also announced Null Consensus upgrade, providing an option for subnet to expand the # of miners to 2,500. The potential downside is only 1 validator decides who get the rewards and who don't.

Under the right conditions, this could mean faster iterative loops, more efficient product improvements (would need well-designed scoring system + healthy miners competition ofc)

Can't wait to see the next leg up for both AI on Base and on Bittensor!

[I'm surprised not many people on CT realizes this yet but Onchain AI val remains heavily compressed while metrics are rapidly growing every single week. 

We cover this a lot on Substack so if you're interested, feel free to check that out]
